Sam: Quick follow-up from the sales debrief: drop 1-2 bullets on why we won/lost deals this quarter and any concrete asks for leadership. Keep it short.

Diego: Won: latency + predictable pricing for a fintech POC. Lost: missing signal-routing feature parity. Ask: make a short decision doc on prioritizing signal features.

Avery: Lost a mid-market deal; they wanted a one-step on-prem install. Ask: one-page Private quickstart + installer script.

Priya: Win theme: KV cache + batching cut token cost in demos. Ask: official benchmark snippet SEs can paste.

Lina: CS: Console observability was a trust driver. Loss: KMS/HSM still blocks some enterprise buys. Ask: timeline for managed KMS integration?

Jordan: SE: confusions about model variants and fallbacks in demos. Ask: short "which model to pick" guide (latency / cost / quality).

Mali: Customer story: health startup chose us after offline eval; caching reduced costs 30%. Docs clarity sold it. Ask: prioritize caching docs + examples.

Diego: Procurement friction on committed capacity contracts too. Ask: sales+legal to standardize a mid-market contract template.

Sam: Good list. I'll triage these asks: quickstart, benchmark snippet, KMS timeline, model guide, caching docs, contract template. Reply +1 to confirm or add an item.

Avery: +1. Add: onboarding checklist in Console for Private (steps + expected time).

Priya: +1. I'll draft the benchmark snippet this week.

Lina: +1. I'll post a KMS ETA in #eng-security by EOD Friday.

Jordan: +1. Will draft the 3-tier model guide and post in #eng-ml for review.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands survey going out in 10 minutes.

Sam: Thanks all 8522; I'll make a triage board and ping owners tomorrow. If anyone has short customer quotes (1-2 lines) add them here for PRDs.
